evidence.detail: preaggregate_season_archetype_playability() exists — computes relative card frequency per archetype vs overall, exactly the data needed for 'high synergy cards'
archetype() controller does not load any synergy/new-card data; only loads archetype stats and matchups
cards2 API accepts archetype_id but returns all cards sorted by frequency only — no high-synergy or new-card sections
Author describes three distinct EDHREC-style sections wanted: 'new cards', 'high synergy cards', 'top cards', plus per-type subsections

triage.notes: The underlying data for 'high synergy' already exists in _season_archetype_playability (archetype card frequency ÷ overall frequency). Implementing EDHREC-style sections requires: a new API endpoint (or query param) to return synergy-ranked cards, new UI sections on the archetype page, and design decisions on thresholds and which card types to show per section.
